reviews.title: RM1000x is a beast
reviews.comment: Solid buy! The RM1000x is a beast. I needed a reliable 1000W unit to handle my new GPU, and this delivers consistent power without any coil whine. The build quality is top-tier, and because it's fully modular, I only had to use the cables I actually needed. It's incredibly quiet—the fan doesn't even spin up during lighter tasks. Worth every penny for the peace of mind.
reviews.author: Mark Monroe

reviews.title: Recertified power supply works great
reviews.comment: I just installed it and arrived in a brown box since it was recertified. Came with cables it powered up and is working fine now I have not noticed anything wrong ran test software and it passed.  Price was good arrived next day
reviews.author: Sugaman

reviews.title: Great buy
reviews.comment: Works great and keeps cool, unlike my old power supply that got hot. I haven't had any issues with it at all. Just don't forget to check your cmos battery before you upgrade your power supply. That was my issue thinking it was a power issue since it kept going straight to bios and resetting.
reviews.author: Adrian Brambila

reviews.title: Powerful!
reviews.comment: Probably more power than I needed, but I am set for any other builds with this if I go bigger on a build.
reviews.author: Dean

reviews.title: Super quiet. Good power
reviews.comment: Works perfectly, the only thing I wish it had was an RGB fan or some kind of RGB light but other than that the thing works super good super quiet.
